in_sanskrit.name: दशविका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दश (Dash) meaning ten and विका (Vikā) meaning goddesses. So, the name Dashvika means Ten Goddesses.

in_marathi.name: Dashvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ten steps, ten powers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dashvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dashvika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Dash’ meaning ten and ‘Vik’ meaning powers or steps. In Hindu mythology, Dashavatara refers to the ten avatars of Vishnu. Dashvika could be considered a feminine form of Dashavatara or a name for a girl with ten unique qualities or powers.
